sessions.prompt:
Add parse_amount(s) to money.py: an amount string such as "12.50" becomes int cents (1250). Add tests.

The plan for parse_amount has one more step: it also accepts a leading "$" and thousands commas ("$1,234.50" becomes 123450). Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): an amount must be positive: any function given an amount of zero or less raises ValueError and changes nothing.

Design decision for this project: an account may be overdrawn: its balance may go down to -5000 cents.

given.handoff: Session 1 added parse_amount(s) with tests. Its last step is left for later: accept a leading "$" and thousands commas.
decisions: An amount must be positive: zero or less raises ValueError and changes nothing, in any function.
An account may be overdrawn down to -5000 cents.

sessions.prompt:
Add a Ledger class to ledger.py with open(account), deposit(account, cents), withdraw(account, cents) and balance(account). Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): account names ignore case: "Ann" and "ANN" are the same account, in every function.

Design decision for this project: each withdrawal costs a fee of 100 cents, taken from the balance.

Design decision for this project: the last line of a statement is the balance in the form BALANCE: 12.50.

given.handoff: Session 2 added Ledger.open, deposit, withdraw and balance with tests.
decisions: Account names ignore case in every function.
Each withdrawal costs a fee of 100 cents, taken from the balance.
The last statement line is the balance: BALANCE: 12.50.

sessions.prompt:
Add Ledger.transfer(src, dst, cents) to ledger.py: it moves cents from one account to another. Transfers have no fee. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the withdrawal fee is 25 cents, not 100.

Design decision for this project: opening an account that already exists raises ValueError.

Design decision for this project: a transfer from an account to itself raises ValueError.

decisions: Supersedes 100 cents: the withdrawal fee is 25 cents.
Opening an account that already exists raises ValueError.
A transfer from an account to itself raises ValueError.

sessions.prompt:
Add Ledger.history(account) to ledger.py: the account's balance changes in order, as signed cents (a deposit of 500 is 500, a withdrawal of 200 is -200, and a fee is its own entry). Add tests.

The plan for Ledger.history has one more step: it takes an optional n and then returns only the last n entries. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): no account may be overdrawn: a withdrawal (with its fee) or a transfer that would take a balance below 0 raises ValueError and changes nothing.

given.handoff: Session 4 added Ledger.history(account) with tests. Its last step is left for later: an optional n returns only the last n entries.
decisions: Supersedes the -5000 overdraft: a withdrawal (with fee) or transfer taking a balance below 0 raises ValueError and changes nothing.

sessions.prompt:
Add fmt_money(cents) to statement.py: 123450 becomes "1234.50". Add tests.

The plan for fmt_money has one more step: thousands are separated by commas ("1,234.50"). Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

given.handoff: Session 5 added fmt_money(cents) with tests. Its last step is left for later: thousands commas.

sessions.prompt:
Add Ledger.accounts() to ledger.py: the sorted list of account names, in lower case. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the last line of a statement has the form Closing balance: $12.50, not BALANCE: 12.50.

Design decision for this project: monthly interest is 1% of the balance up to 100000 cents plus 2% of the part above, rounded down to a whole cent.

Design decision for this project: the first line of a statement is the account name in upper case, in the form ACCOUNT ANN.

decisions: Supersedes BALANCE: 12.50: the last statement line is Closing balance: $12.50.
Monthly interest is 1% up to 100000 cents plus 2% of the part above, rounded down.
The first statement line is the account name in upper case: ACCOUNT ANN.

sessions.prompt: Add monthly_interest(balance) to interest.py: the interest in cents (an int) for one month on that balance. Add tests.

Add write_statement(ledger, account, path) to statement.py: it writes a text statement with one line per history entry and the balance. Add tests. Then finish any work that earlier sessions left for later.
